test.name: "Continue." on a project whose objective disputes the parents runs the verify path
test.description: Issue #4791: a first message that asks to verify a person's relationships becomes the project's objective, and the researcher may answer the setup stop with a bare "Continue.". The objective then stands in for the reply: forget-and-rederive runs in verify mode on the disputed parents with cleanSlate, then the baseline, then question-selection with a `statedQuestion:` line about the parents. disputed-parents-unsourced's objective says the attached parents are believed to be incorrect.
